name: Runtime Validation (Schemas at the Edges)
shortDescription: Schema-based validation for API inputs/outputs using libraries like Zod and Valibot.
description: We validate API inputs/outputs and webhook payloads with schema libraries (e.g., Zod, Valibot) to stop bad data at boundaries.
Schemas double as client contracts and improve testability. See “API & Integration → Schema Definition & Validation” for our defaults.
useCases: Form data validation with detailed errors
